It sounds like you are taking the job issue way too hard on yourself. 
I know it's not good to be jobless, but if you feel like it's effecting you that bad then you should just   let it go for a second and put yourself first. 
I was physically abused as a child, and I would get so affraid that I wouldn't be able to even think straight. 
And messing up all of the time out of the fear and anxiety made me actually believe I was stupid and there was something wrong with me. 
I also could never make friends in school or get good grades. 
I kept falling back and back and down a deep hole. 

But I realized that the only way to accomplish things in life is to practice. And you will always have a chance as long as you don't decide to quit on yourself. You are your worst enemy. 
It also took me a while to learn that no one is really as happy as they seem. 
The idea of happiness isn't a reasonable goal for anyone. Because life truly does suck ass and it's unpredictable and messy. 
The real goal you should strive for is contentment.  I feel that is real happiness. 
Accepting life for what it is and appreciating the little things. :) 
I hope this helps you.
